title: still present since round 2: download_timeout and store_of duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam
detail: r2 finding 21: the deliberate-but-documented duplication was not hoisted; both helpers still exist twice (store_of duplicates demo_store_of incl. the seed fallback).
recommended_fix: Hoist the shared helpers into a demo module or client helpers.

title: still present since round 2: Demo reminders and bulk-invite mutate nothing; hardcoded counts contradict the awaiting list
detail: r2 finding 24: success toasts report counts that don't correspond to the seeded awaiting list (v-maples seeds 3 awaiting, 1 un-reminded), and the awaiting rows never reflect a sent reminder.
recommended_fix: Derive counts from the store (or mark reminders sent in the store).

title: still present since round 2: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention - ids can collide
evidence:
demo_update.gleam:617: let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1
  ...
      next_toast_id: toast_id,
vs client.gleam:7089 (add_toast): let id = model.next_toast_id
detail: r2 finding 25: a demo toast takes id N+1 and leaves next_toast_id at N+1, so the next handler toast reuses the same id; the first timeout dismisses both. The 5-toast cap is also missing (plain list.append).
recommended_fix: Route demo toasts through the shared add_toast (or match its id convention and cap).

title: still present since round 2: id_suffix truncation guarantees id/short_code collisions for same-prefix property names
detail: r2 finding 27: two same-prefix creations (e.g. two 'My Apartment ...') produce identical v-demo- ids/RTDEMO short_codes; the store is keyed by id and the anti-collision comment promises uniqueness it doesn't deliver.
recommended_fix: Append a per-store counter to the suffix.

title: still present since round 2: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
detail: r2 finding 28: returns the full list for any page while the response handler appends; latent only today (demo first page returns everything so load-more never renders), but any render-condition change duplicates every row.
recommended_fix: Slice the page or replace instead of append for demo.

title: still present since round 2: Store-side mark_opened has no status guard - documented idempotency rests on the dispatch-layer set
detail: r2 finding 29: change_status overwrites status and appends an audit row unconditionally; the idempotency guard lives only in client.gleam's open_dispatched set, so any future second dispatch path double-appends. Latent only.

title: still present since round 2: Zero-caller demo exports shipped (demo_store.notifications orphan)
detail: r2 finding 19 residual: the demo_store.notifications export still has zero callers (only notifications_unread is used, via demo_api.gleam:366). Other r2-19 orphans (demo_api.check_session) were removed.
recommended_fix: Delete the orphan export or wire it.
